integrity: The included analytical proof gives the all-parameter result. Exact rational tests are reproducibility checks, not substitutes for proof. No independent mathematical assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares only stationary single-time output variance for the two specified unit-rate architectures with independent Poisson immigration-death sources. It does not compare integrated temporal autocorrelation or alternative rates; a relevant earlier tandem-queue paper was available only in publisher preview.
title: A sharp distributive-law variance crossover in stochastic arithmetic networks
